dict.string: Interline reads calendar events on your Mac to prepare meeting notes. They leave it only if you ask a configured AI provider to use them.
Interline records your voice and transcribes audio on your Mac. Transcripts leave it only if you ask a configured AI provider to use them.
Interline records meeting audio and transcribes it on your Mac. Transcripts leave it only if you ask a configured AI provider to use them.
